name: Recall key points after one week
short_description: Recall key points after one week once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can recall key points after one week in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Recall key points after one week means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Recall key points after one week in a fresh real-life scenario.
